description: Terrain route planning (cards M5-07/M5-08, P Part 4 Step 5.7). Airframe values are installation data for a generic single-engine MALE UAV class (no public data for a specific airframe): ASSUMED. The engine side comes from the calibrated engine model (configs/engines), never from this file.

dem.ref: Copernicus GLO-30 DSM, ESA/Airbus, public AWS open data registry (registry.opendata.aws/copernicus-dem); tile N34 E077 covers Leh / Ladakh

block_px.ref: planning cell = 60 x 60 DEM posts (about 1.85 km x 1.5 km at 34 N); cell elevation = block maximum (conservative)

min_layer_ft.ref: lowest layer (below the Indus valley floor)

min_clearance_ft.ref: minimum terrain clearance above the cell maximum (en-route 300 m class margin)

min_climb_rate_fpm.ref: service-ceiling definition: highest altitude with at least 100 ft/min climb

climb_cost_m_per_m.ref: route cost: metres of horizontal distance equivalent to 1 m of climb (energy)

mass_kg.ref: single-engine MALE UAV class take-off mass

cd0.ref: parasite drag coefficient, clean MALE airframe

climb_eas_kt.ref: climb speed held as equivalent airspeed

airfields.ref: aerodrome reference points from public listings (checked 20 Nov 2026); demonstration presets only, not for navigation

value.name: Kargil
value.ref: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kargil_Airport ; https://lfs.aero/flight-support/india/VI65 (ICAO VI65; the old glide.py list called it VIKG, which is Kishangarh)

value.name: Srinagar
value.ref: https://skyvector.com/airport/VISR/Srinagar-Airport (33 59.3 N, 74 46.5 E, 5437 ft MSL; other listings give 5429-5495 ft)

feathering_propeller.ref: no feathering propeller is configured for the modelled installations (configs/installations/propellers.json); a stopped engine is assumed to windmill

windmill_ld_factor.ref: L/D with a windmilling propeller relative to the clean (feathered) polar; carried over from the earlier glide module, no airframe source

pattern_height_ft.ref: height above the airfield at which the glide must arrive (high-key entry)

glide_clearance_ft.ref: minimum height above terrain anywhere along a glide path

confident_margin_ft.ref: arrival margin above which a divert is REACHABLE_CONFIDENT rather than MARGINAL

path_step_m.ref: terrain sampling step along a glide path (DEM post spacing is about 30 m; ridges narrower than this step can be missed)

footprint_bearings.ref: number of radial directions in the reachability footprint

start_position.ref: simulation start position = Leh aerodrome reference point (airfield VILH above); the operator or a mission moves it
